title: Emrys and the Verdict
author: P. M. Reyes
blurb: Jonah Okafor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
